final: WITH per_currency AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate FROM per_currency), qualifying AS (SELECT p.avg_rebate, p.avg_relative_gap, p.avg_rebate - b.avg_rebate AS excess FROM per_currency AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_rebate > b.avg_rebate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_average_maker_rebate, AVG(avg_relative_gap) AS mean_average_relative_gap, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM qualifying
